name: seonix
description: Connect your Seonix SEO project: Site Health and fix plan, Google Search Console, keywords, articles and SEO playbooks, with skills that fix a site in code and ship content through Seonix.

interface.longDescription: Seonix grows organic and AI-search visibility for a website on autopilot. This plugin connects the agent to your Seonix project over MCP: Site Health and the prioritised fix plan, Google Search Console, keyword clusters and the content calendar, articles and draft scoring, and eleven SEO playbooks. Write actions (start a scan, apply or roll back a Seonix fix on WordPress, mark an issue as intentional) run only after you confirm. Requires a Seonix account on a paid plan.
capabilities: Read the Site Health report and prioritised fix plan
Read Google Search Console queries, pages and opportunities
Browse keywords, clusters, calendar and articles
Score a draft with Seonix SEO checks
Start scans and apply Seonix fixes with confirmation
defaultPrompt: What are the biggest SEO problems on my site right now?
Which search queries are close to page one and worth a push?
Check this draft against my site's SEO rules before I publish it.
